chinjiaqing/jc-daily-report.body:
# ⚽ Football Signal Radar · Daily Signal Report

> **Set emotion aside, watch only the signals.**
> Cross-validation of three channels of handicap movement; no bets on low odds, none when signals are unclear. Automatic before kickoff, automatic settlement after the match.

## 🚀 Online Site

- **[https://chinjiaqing.github.io/jc-daily-report/](https://chinjiaqing.github.io/jc-daily-report/)**
- Automatically updated every hour, historical dates archived, available for review at any time
- Covers **500~1300+** matches per day (full JingCai/Asian handicap coverage), automatically flags signals and bets

---

## The Detours We Bypassed

We tried **models**: piled up parameters until the room was full. Looking back, the model merely recited prices the market had already set; no matter how many parameters, it could produce nothing new.

We tried **studying the bookmakers**: guessing at the bookie's moves, guessing more and more, until it looked like paranoia. Eventually it became clear: guessing the bookie is less useful than watching the price.

We also tried **AI prediction**: injuries, motivation, form. Each point was argued convincingly, and each had long been written into the odds. However loud the argument, the handicap doesn't accept it.

After the detours, one plain principle remains:

> **Where the money flows, the handicap speaks.**
> But people watching the market easily get carried away: chasing favorites, fearing upsets, shaking under pressure at the last minute. It is easy to see that emotion is driving the trade.

So we hand both the "watching" and the "buying" to the machine, and people keep only one thing: **discipline**.

## Three Informants, One Referee

**1X2 (European odds)** tracks market-wide odds movements: who is being collectively abandoned, who is quietly defending, and whether the draw defense line has been given up. This is the informant closest to the action.

**Asian handicap** tracks the handicap line and water (odds): sudden last-minute pivots, and the sniping of money on the upper side. The money was slammed down in real cash, which is more reliable than what people say.

**Over/Under** tracks the total-goals line: when a goal-scoring hotbed appears, the number of goals in that match has often already been foreseen.

Each of the three informants has its own news. When the news agrees, the referee dares to make the call; **for matches where they disagree (1X2 and Asian handicap fighting each other), we don't touch them at all**. When the informants themselves are arguing, what use is it to place a bet?

## Discipline Matters More Than Vision

Once the direction is set, everything left is discipline:

- **No bets on low odds**: single-selection odds under 1.5, or double-selection odds below 1.3 after discounting, and even the best signal is not bought. At that level of odds, even a win doesn't earn much money.
- **No bets when signals are unclear**: no signal, conflicting signals, or ambiguous direction means waiting, no exceptions. Missing a bet doesn't lose money; a wrong bet does.
- **Quality determines stake size**: the harder the signal, the larger the stake (1/2/4 units). No all-in gambling.
- **Automatic betting 15 minutes before kickoff, automatic settlement when results come in**: no last-minute shaking hands, no urge to raise stakes after winning or to chase losses after losing.

---

## ⚠️ Disclaimer

This project is for data research only and does not constitute any purchase advice. Please buy lottery tickets at offline physical stores. Persons under 18 years of age may not participate.

# dsh-learning-assistant

Learning Assistant: supplements explanations of technical terms in dsh answers, and provides term cards, a knowledge tree, body-text highlighting, and selection-based explanations in the right sidebar.

## Features

- After an answer finishes, automatically supplements technical terms that were not explained; the model can also record them proactively.
- Select text in the body to generate an explanation and a learning path.
- The right sidebar provides a "Terms / Knowledge tree" view, with filtering by the current conversation.
- Recorded terms are highlighted in the body; clicking a highlight locates its card, and double-clicking a card locates the body text.
- Clicking a concept in a learning path fills it into the chat input to continue asking.
- Supports adjusting the user level and explanation preference; terms are remembered across conversations.

## Requirements

- Verified: **dsh 0.2.2-rc.1, Node.js 22 / 24**. Other dsh versions are not yet verified.
- Installation invokes `pnpm` from dsh, so make sure `pnpm` is on the PATH of the dsh process.
- Installing from GitHub also requires `git` on the PATH.

The plugin neither bundles nor installs dsh.

## Installation

### Via the dsh UI (recommended)

Open "Settings → Plugins → Add plugin", enter the address below and install; restart dsh when finished:

```text
https://github.com/crocodile-yzl/dsh-learning-assistant
```

### Via the command line

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/crocodile-yzl/dsh-learning-assistant
```

For local development, you can also install from a directory directly:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add <插件目录的绝对路径>
```

Uninstall:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-learning-assistant
```

## Usage

1. Ask questions normally. When a term needing explanation appears in an answer, click "术语 N" in the conversation title bar to open the right sidebar.
2. Switch between "This conversation / All", or switch to "Knowledge tree" to view term relationships.
3. Select text in the body and click "解释这个词" to add a new term card.
4. Click a body highlight to locate its term card; double-click a card to flash the corresponding term in the body.
5. Click a concept in a card's learning path to fill it into the chat input and continue asking.

Term data is saved by default at `$DSH_HOME/dsh-learning-assistant/terms.json`; if `DSH_HOME` is not set, it is saved at `~/.dsh/dsh-learning-assistant/terms.json`.

# Meow~Detective

## Project Introduction

Meow~Detective is designed for local, offline analysis of disk images, logical directories, Android images, and Linux/PVE evidence sources. The current backend workspace contains 53 Rust crates. Storage is layered into a control plane and detail data: a case-level database handles cases, data source registration, tasks, and auditing; each data source's `source.db` stores the control plane, processing stages, and publication receipts; partitions, file trees, artifacts, timelines, and in-source indexes are persisted as atomic Fjall generations in the case workspace; and the rebuildable case-level cross-source relationship projection is stored in `indexes/case-graph.db`.

The current project fact snapshot includes 12 frontend pages, 171 Tauri commands, 58 source modules, migration scripts (83), and 173 test files. Counts are checked for synchronization with the repository structure by `scripts/check-doc-drift.ps1`.

RAW/E01 import uses a job-level SourceRuntime, independent readers, and a shared E01 OpenPlan. The default worker count is `min(CPU count, 2)`. Concurrency is constrained jointly by estimated resource admission with a 1536 MB soft limit and an independent 2048 MB RSS hard limit. Source metadata identity is used for resume binding and invalidation checks, while evidence content digests are still generated by the byte verification path.

On startup it triggers UAC and runs with an administrator token. Physical disk mounting uses the system `MSiSCSI` service. The application may temporarily start this service during mounting, and after the service lease ends, it restores the startup type that the application itself changed. The application does not automatically install Dokan or iSCSI components, and does not forcibly stop the `MSiSCSI` service, which may be in use by other programs. > The same armor-breaking approach, moved to Google Antigravity: **use the host's own hooks to sit upstream of the approval gate and the model calls, without touching `app.asar` or modifying `language_server.exe`.**

`agy-purge` is the Antigravity counterpart of [dsh-purge](https://github.com/YuJunZhiXue/dsh-purge) (DeepSeek Harness armor-breaking). dsh-purge has to patch because DSH exposes no extension points. The override prompt is upgraded to v3, specifically targeting "policy self-review + trailing disclaimer", for Antigravity 2.35 / the `gemini-4-neon-high` generation of models. `status` also records the host build fingerprint, so after an upgrade you can see at a glance whether the plugin is still configured for the current version.

**[Official site](https://iotahome.site) · [My devices](https://iotahome.site/zh/devices) · [IOTA lookup](https://iotahome.site/zh/app) · [Network status](https://iotahome.site/zh/network) · [Blog](https://iotahome.site/zh/blog) · [English](https://iotahome.site/en)**

IOTA Watch is an independent MIT-licensed monitor in English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean and Japanese. IOTA Train at Home (Macrocosmos / Bittensor SN9) is the core project, with ten project pages covering training, mining and compute. Tool pages query records; separate tutorials explain identifiers, fields and troubleshooting. Public projects use public identifiers; io.net and Vast.ai require account connections with read credentials. Those two integrations have mocked validation; real-account validation remains pending.

基于 Node.js 的 QQ 农场自动化工具，提供多账号挂机、农场与好友自动化、独立图鉴与藏品、活动中心、商城、数据分析和 Web 控制面板。当前项目版本为 `20261117`，QQ 与微信游戏协议版本均为 `1.17.1.10_20261117`，两端独立维护版本配置和 TSDK/WASM。

## 功能概览

### 账号与登录

- 游戏账号可无限添加并独立运行，每个账号可单独配置种植、好友、自动化和执行间隔策略
- 支持抓包 Code 登录、微信扫码登录和 QQ扫码登录
- 支持账号启停、状态监控、实时日志和离线提醒
- Web 面板只保留一个超级管理员，不提供注册、普通用户和租户隔离

### 农场自动化

- 自动收获、种植、浇水、除草、除虫、铲除和土地升级
- 自动施肥、多季作物补肥、指定土地类型施肥和化肥自动购买
- 支持一键务农、一键种植、一键收获、一键铲除和一键全收等面板操作
- 支持多种种植策略、背包种子优先级、作物黑名单和执行间隔配置
- 汇总任务、免费礼包、分享奖励、会员礼包、月卡礼包和图鉴奖励等每日状态，并按天自动处理支持的领取项

### 图鉴

- 在“个人 → 图鉴”中查看作物图鉴和超变图鉴的等级、进度及果实收藏状态
- 作物图鉴按游戏配置排序展示作物，收藏奖励统一放在详情弹窗中查看
- 超变图鉴依据 `Illustrated.json` 的 `param` 和 `type` 字段区分黄金果实、活动果实与装扮果实，不依赖果实名或协议奖励分类字段推断
- 超变属性弹窗顶部汇总当前生效加成，等级列表展示属性名称、触发概率或数量，以及已达成状态或所需进度
- 移动端图鉴使用四列果实布局，等级进度和弹窗样式与现有面板保持一致

### 好友互动

- 自动访问好友、偷菜、帮忙浇水、除草除虫及放草放虫
- 支持好友黑名单、安静时段和互动经验上限
- 支持已知好友 GID 的批量维护、同步参数和互动记录查询
- 好友巡查合并为单次访问：每位好友只进一次农场，一次做完帮忙（除草/除虫/浇水）、偷菜和捣乱（放草/放虫）
- 好友上场宠物按天缓存：进好友农场时顺手记录，另有后台分批的每日补齐，“护主犬经验满仍帮忙”不再每轮逐个进农场试探
- 面板可对指定好友执行单次访问或农场操作

# sailflow

> **Tribute to [Slickflow](https://github.com/besley/slickflow)**  
> This repository is a secondary rework of the open-source workflow engine [Slickflow](https://github.com/besley/slickflow). Thanks to Besley, Hangzhou Ligong Technology, and the community for their outstanding contributions. The upstream project is licensed under MIT; for source licensing details, see [NOTICE](https://github.com/sailuosi/SailFlow/blob/HEAD/NOTICE).

**Pluggable · Extensible · Multi-database · .NET 6 / 8 / 10**

A self-developed workflow engine, still under iteration. **Basic flow transitions have passed testing.** Compared with upstream Slickflow, the data layer, structure, and frontend have been reworked. From here on it will **continue to evolve independently** and no longer sync with upstream source code.

---

## Core Capabilities at a Glance

| # | Capability | Summary |
|---|------|--------|
| 1 | **Plugin architecture** | StartUp / `UseXxx` mounting and registration; maximum extensibility and flexibility |
| 2 | **Clear layering** | pure / ext / biz with distinct responsibilities; heavyweight dependencies can be swapped as plugins |
| 3 | **Database adaptation** | Depends on **mooSQL**, easily adapting to various databases |
| 4 | **Multi-framework compatibility** | Target frameworks `net6.0;net8.0;net10.0;net11.0` built as multiple targets in one repository |
| 5 | **Fully pluggable capabilities** | Forms, documents, configuration, rules, language packs, messages, and events can all be mounted on demand |
| 6 | **China-style OA actions** | Approve / reject / return / countersign (three types) / transfer / communicate / CC, etc. The engine covers them all, and task-handling options map one-to-one |
| 7 | **Assignee slots** | Multiple built-in strategies plus a business strategy pipeline, so even unusual assignment logic can be plugged in |
| 8 | **Events and callbacks** | Gate / Hook / Notifier, with sync / async / Outbox slots for multiple scenarios |
| 9 | **Enhanced table-sharding strategy** | Hot/cold archiving, cold tables by year, and sharding with a whitelist on the hot side, making operations easier |
| 10 | **Examples and demos** | Multiple plugin samples; `UseXxx` enhancements work out of the box |

---

### 1. Plugin architecture · StartUp-style mounting

Aligned with the ASP.NET Core mindset of "enabling capability packages": one toggleable capability = one `UseXxx`. It is declared in a chain on `SailClientBuilder`, and enablement checks, table creation, and Hook/Notifier registration are all encapsulated inside the extension.

thedvxch/yandex-music.body:
A typed, asynchronous **TypeScript client for the Yandex Music API**.

`@dvxch/yandex-music` is an independent implementation of the Yandex Music HTTP API in TypeScript. It targets modern Node.js (≥ 20), ships as ESM with full type declarations, and has **no runtime dependencies** (it uses the built-in `fetch`).

> Status: ready. The entire HTTP API is implemented and tested — `account` / `tracks` / `albums` / `artists` / `search` / `likes` / `playlists` / `device auth` / `landing` / `radio` / `queue` / `history` / `clips` / `credits` / `disclaimers` / `labels` / `metatags` / `pins` / `presaves` / `concerts` — including playlist mutations, dislikes and rotor feedback, as well as realtime "now playing" via Ynison.

Every endpoint has been run against the live Yandex Music API with a real token. The few endpoints the server no longer serves to a regular account (for example, the legacy queue creation and rotor feedback) throw a typed error rather than failing silently.

# outage-data-ua

Public repository and tools for automatic collection, parsing, HTML visualization, and automatic generation of PNG images of scheduled and emergency electricity outage charts in Ukraine.

The project retrieves data from public web pages of energy providers and stores it as JSON "as is" in the `data/` directory. This data is then rendered with a fixed HTML template and converted into PNG images, which are saved to `images/<region>/gpv-x-x.png`.

---

Each region is stored in a file `data/<region>.json`. Basic structure (abridged):

```json
{
  "regionId": "kyiv",

}
```

wjn6/GongXi-Mail.body:
# GongXi Mail (廾匸邮箱)

An API service for receiving mail using Microsoft OAuth2.

## Tech Stack

- **Backend**: Fastify 5 + TypeScript + Prisma 6
- **Database**: PostgreSQL
- **Cache**: Redis
- **Frontend**: React + Ant Design + Vite

## Project Structure

```
├── server/                 # Backend service
│   ├── src/
│   │   ├── config/        # Environment configuration
│   │   ├── lib/           # Core library
│   │   ├── plugins/       # Fastify plugins
│   │   ├── modules/       # Business modules
│   ├── prisma/            # Database schema
│   └── package.json
├── web/                    # Admin dashboard frontend
├── docker-compose.yml
└── Dockerfile
```

## Quick Start

### Docker Deployment

Secrets do not need to be prepared manually: on first startup, `JWT_SECRET`, `ENCRYPTION_KEY`, and a strong random `ADMIN_PASSWORD` are generated automatically and persisted to `data/bootstrap-secrets.json` in the `app_data` volume (they remain unchanged after restarting and rebuilding the container). The initial admin password is printed only once in the first-startup logs; you can retrieve it at any time with `docker compose logs app | grep "initial admin password"`.

To pin the keys (e.g., for sharing across multiple instances), explicitly inject the environment variables before startup; explicit values always take precedence over auto-generated ones:

```bash
export JWT_SECRET="replace-with-at-least-32-char-random-secret"
export ENCRYPTION_KEY="replace-with-32-character-secret-key"
export ADMIN_PASSWORD="replace-with-strong-password"
```

Then start:

```bash
docker-compose up -d --build
```

Visit http://localhost:3000

> Note: The `app_data` volume stores the `ENCRYPTION_KEY` that encrypted data depends on. Deleting this volume will make the stored refresh tokens undecryptable, so treat it the same way you would a database volume.

xiayuan0817/Azur-Promilia-Chinese-Transl.body:
# Azur Promilia Simplified Chinese Localization / Erran Issue Feedback QQ Group: 1055713417 (often offline, group is full...)

Simplified Chinese localization tool for the Taiwan and Japan servers of *Azur Promilia: Rover Rumors* (《蓝色星原：旅谣》) game and launcher. Supports localization, anti-virtualization removal, restoration, and file verification.

> **If you cannot log in, restore the files. This project has not been tested for anti-cheat and later versions are not guaranteed to be compatible.**

## Download

Go to [Releases](https://github.com/xiayuan0817/Azur-Promilia-Chinese-Translation-Script/releases) to download the complete localization package:

**`AzurPromilia-Localization-Full-v6.zip`**

The full package includes the run scripts and replacement resources; no separate CN-server package is needed.

**The repository source code does not include game replacement resources. Downloading the repository ZIP alone cannot complete the localization.**

## How to Use

1. Fully extract the localization package and keep the original directory structure.
2. For items whose files need modifying, first exit the corresponding game or launcher, including tray programs.
3. Double-click **`双击运行.bat`** (Double-click to run.bat).
4. Enter the number and press Enter to execute.

| Option | Function |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | Localize all |
| 2 | Restore all |
| 3 | Localize selected items |
| 4 | Restore selected items |
| 5 | View file and backup status |
| 6 | Full verification (including segment and whole-package CRC32) |
| 7 | Manually add/modify install directory (can save to `tools/安装路径.json`) |
| 8 | Japan server anti-virtualization removal |
| 9 | Restore Japan server anti-virtualization removal |
| 10 | Taiwan server anti-virtualization removal |
| 11 | Restore Taiwan server anti-virtualization removal |
| U | Check for and update the localization package |
| Q | Quit |

Taiwan and Japan server anti-virtualization removal are both operated from the same `双击运行.bat` menu and are not executed by Localize all or Restore all. Options `5` and `6` include their file, backup status, and CRC32 checks. The anti-virtualization resources correspond to Japan server `1.0.2` and Taiwan server resource version `3221746`, and only accept matching original or current-version files.

When selecting some items, separate multiple numbers with commas, e.g. `1,3`; press Enter to select all, and `0` or `q` to cancel.

Each item only checks its own process; items already localized or restored are skipped directly. When an item is running, the reason is shown and the other items continue to be processed.

- Automatically searches common locations, the registry, running processes, and desktop/Start menu shortcuts for the install directory.
- If not found, you can drag the install folder onto the **`双击运行.bat`** icon, or enter the path at the window prompt.
- Option `7` can add or modify the install directory; enter `Y` to save it so it is read automatically next time, or `N` to use it only for this run.
- You can also enter the absolute path in `tools/安装路径.json`.
